releaseNotes:
Now Playing and the mini player use the length reported by the audio player. The title, artwork, and timing follow the active queue item when playback advances.

Nightify checks audio before playback and tries another available encoding when a stream is unreadable. SoundCloud previews are skipped when only part of a recording is available. Playback errors show a shorter message.

Update in place from **Settings → Updates → Check for updates**.
